identification: Louisa Anne Meredith, Our Island Home: A Tasmanian Sketch Book (Hobart: J. Walch; London: Marcus Ward, 1879), folio, olive/brown gilt-decorated cloth with Huon pine cone design. Photos show autotype plates (Proctor's Road, South Arm, Herne Bay, Wine-Glass Bay, Cape Raoul). Single edition, so any 1879 copy is the first. Cloth rubbed and stained, spine ends frayed, foxing, back pastedown covered with 1930s Mercury glider cuttings and photos (adds minor local aviation interest, not book value). Title page and plate count not seen; the full book has 12 plates.
